desktopOnly.title: Desktop Only
desktopOnly.description: LLM Wiki workspace setup is currently available only inside the local desktop app.

hero.title: Turn your Obsidian vault into a maintained LLM Wiki.
hero.description: Deeting reads your vault locally, creates a bounded managed workspace, and keeps it synchronized through retrieval, delegated maintenance, and long-term knowledge growth.
hero.writeScope: Writes only to the managed workspace

metrics.notesHint: Vault notes available for local retrieval
metrics.attachmentsHint: Files that can feed summaries and source pages

journey.title: Move from local vault binding to explicit wiki delegation.
journey.description: Keep the system bounded: connect the vault, bootstrap the managed workspace and dedicated corpus, then verify the maintainer-only retrieval path before handing off wiki work.
journey.boundary: The main assistant still stays off this corpus by default. The maintainer path only becomes active after an explicit handoff.

connect.title: Connect Vault
connect.description: Bind the existing Obsidian vault and confirm the local read boundary before Deeting touches anything else.
connect.ready: {vaultName} is connected and {count} markdown notes are visible for local scan.
connect.pending: Analyze the vault root first so Deeting can confirm the scan scope and managed workspace target.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap + Sync
bootstrap.description: Create the bounded wiki scaffold, then sync the dedicated corpus that only the maintainer agent will use.
bootstrap.ready: Workspace is ready at {path} and the dedicated corpus has {count} indexed notes.
bootstrap.pending: Create the managed workspace and run at least one corpus sync before the maintainer can search local wiki evidence.

handoff.title: Inspect + Handoff
handoff.description: Exercise the corpus inspector, then sync the maintainer agent so delegated wiki work stays visible and bounded.
handoff.ready: Inspector has been exercised with {count} visible result(s), and {name} is ready for delegated maintenance.
handoff.pending: Run a corpus query and sync the maintainer agent before delegating wiki work.
handoff.pendingWithMaintainer: {name} is ready. Run a corpus query once to verify exactly what maintainer-only context it will see.

binding.title: Connect the vault you already use.
binding.description: Paste the absolute vault path, then let Deeting scan it locally and reserve a managed workspace inside it.

safety.title: Read broad, write narrow
safety.description: Deeting can read the whole vault for context, but the default write scope stays inside the managed workspace only.

vaultRoot.label: Obsidian Vault Root
vaultRoot.description: Use the absolute path to your existing Obsidian vault.

workspacePath.label: Managed Workspace Path
workspacePath.description: Relative to the vault root. Deeting writes the LLM Wiki here.

workspace.title: Bootstrap the managed wiki, not just an index.
workspace.description: Deeting creates the minimum files needed for a usable LLM Wiki and personalizes them from the vault scan.
workspace.pathPlaceholder: Analyze a vault first to resolve the workspace path.

lifecycle.title: Reuse Deeting's local retrieval and maintenance stack.
lifecycle.description: The page is only the product surface. Underneath, Deeting can already reuse hybrid retrieval, lifecycle scoring, and delegated maintenance patterns.

scan.title: Index the vault, not the user's memory
scan.description: Vault files first become retrieval inputs through local scanning, embeddings, and lexical indexing.

retrieve.title: Let runtime decide what matters now
retrieve.description: Normal chat stays retrieval-first. Runtime only decides when something deserves a maintenance action.

delegate.title: Delegate markdown maintenance
delegate.description: Task agents own the bounded write path so wiki updates remain reviewable and intentional.

promote.title: Promote only stable conclusions
promote.description: User memory stays narrower than the wiki and only receives durable, high-value knowledge.

corpus.title: Sync the dedicated LLM Wiki corpus.
corpus.description: This corpus stays separate from the main knowledge surface. It reuses shared embedding, BM25, hybrid ranking, and lifecycle mechanics for the wiki maintainer agent only.

preview.title: Preview matches
preview.empty: Run a corpus search to inspect what the maintainer agent can see.
preview.noResults: No corpus matches for the current query.

inspector.title: Live inspector
inspector.empty: Select a corpus result to inspect what the maintainer agent would receive.

agentUses.title: Used by the maintainer agent
agentUses.description: This inspector reflects the same dedicated corpus that the wiki maintainer agent can search during delegated work.

corpus.note: The main assistant does not read from this corpus by default. It is reserved for explicit delegation to the wiki maintainer agent.

agent.title: Wire a task agent to maintain the workspace.
agent.description: Use the generated prompt as the maintenance contract for a custom task agent, then let Deeting delegate wiki work into a bounded write scope.

currentAgent.label: Current Maintainer
currentAgent.emptyDescription: Create one now so Deeting can delegate wiki maintenance into a bounded write scope.

tip.title: Keep the main runtime clean
tip.description: The maintainer agent should update pages, source summaries, and logs. The main chat runtime should stay retrieval-focused and trigger delegation only when needed.

automation.title: Keep automation explicit, bounded, and reviewable.
automation.description: Low-risk refreshes can run automatically. Stronger actions stay visible as suggestions, workflow runs, or memory promotions instead of disappearing into hidden background behavior.

autoSyncOnVaultBound.title: Auto-sync corpus on vault bind
autoSyncOnVaultBound.description: When a vault is bound, run the first dedicated corpus sync automatically.

suggestMaintainerOnWorkspaceBootstrap.title: Suggest maintainer after bootstrap
suggestMaintainerOnWorkspaceBootstrap.description: After the workspace scaffold is ready, suggest creating or syncing the maintainer agent.

autoRefreshInspectorOnCorpusSync.title: Refresh inspector after sync
autoRefreshInspectorOnCorpusSync.description: After corpus sync, create a visible inspector follow-up so the user can review the new retrieval surface.

createCrystallizationCandidatesOnSession.title: Create session-end crystallization candidates
createCrystallizationCandidatesOnSession.description: When a conversation closes or archives, surface a candidate for wiki crystallization instead of silently writing back.

enableScheduleSuggestions.title: Enable schedule suggestions
enableScheduleSuggestions.description: Run a periodic review that suggests stale checks, lint passes, and corpus refreshes.

suggestOnValuableAnswer.title: Suggest wiki capture for valuable answers
suggestOnValuableAnswer.description: When an answer looks durable, create a visible wiki-maintenance candidate.

autoDelegateNewSources.title: Auto-delegate new-source review
autoDelegateNewSources.description: When new source material appears in the dedicated corpus, automatically start a maintainer workflow.

autoDelegateMaintenanceSchedule.title: Auto-delegate maintenance schedule
autoDelegateMaintenanceSchedule.description: On periodic schedule checks, automatically start a maintainer review workflow.

promoteRepeatedStableConclusionsToMemory.title: Promote repeated stable conclusions to memory
promoteRepeatedStableConclusionsToMemory.description: If the same durable conclusion repeats, allow the hook layer to write it into local memory with the write guard.

suggestions.title: Pending suggestions
suggestions.empty: No visible automation suggestions are waiting right now.

audit.title: Recent automation audit
audit.empty: No hook activity has been recorded yet.

boundary.title: Boundary remains intact
boundary.description: These hooks may refresh corpus state, open review workflows, or create local-memory candidates. They do not widen the main assistant's default retrieval path.

toast.bootstrapFailed: Failed to create the managed workspace.

toast.corpusSearchFailed: Failed to search the LLM Wiki corpus.

toast.noPrompt: Maintainer prompt is not ready yet.
